scope: current refactor compatibility surface after the foundation safety disposition

surfaces.shape: documented argv plus human streams and selected JSON documents
surfaces.canonicalization: argv is literal; JSON domain is per-command; no generic JSON equivalence is assumed

surfaces.consumer: WP-CLI operator and host CLI gateway
surfaces.shape: WP-CLI command arguments, human output, duo-command-refusal/v1, command-specific JSON
surfaces.canonicalization: JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES at the command boundary; persisted documents retain their own profiles

surfaces.consumer: compiler, plan, Apply, refresh/rebase, review tooling
surfaces.shape: site.duo.json plus canonical state/, media/, code/ and explicit tombstones
surfaces.canonicalization: Duo\Canon v0 pretty sorted JSON with LF/trailing newline plus post front-matter profile

surfaces.consumer: plan, Apply, deploy, promotion, recovery claim construction
surfaces.shape: typed immutable compiled artifact with outer artifact_hash and revision_hash
surfaces.canonicalization: Duo\Canon v0; hash fields bind the exact canonical payload defined by spec/repo-format.md
evidence_inputs: repository, policy, manifest and code descriptor bytes

surfaces.shape: host-local JSON environment map; overlay wins by environment name
surfaces.canonicalization: input JSON has no signing profile; fixture bytes are frozen separately from semantic decode
evidence_inputs: host command and transport source closure

surfaces.producer: site policy, shipped/site/plugin manifests and reviewed dispositions
surfaces.shape: repository format v2 site policy and manifest/disposition JSON grammars
surfaces.canonicalization: Duo\Canon for authored canonical files; declaration identity is exact bytes plus source/provenance

surfaces.shape: generated manifests/capabilities/registry.json plus docs/capabilities.md and README marker
surfaces.canonicalization: deterministic generator projection; registry bytes are a cache and never authority by themselves

surfaces.producer: subject certification builder and reviewed evidence importer
surfaces.shape: archived v1 bundles plus approved duo-certification-closure/v2 for new candidates
surfaces.canonicalization: canonical signed bundle bytes; v2 categories are defined by docs/contracts/closure-v2.schema.json

surfaces.producer: agent scope planner and host scope command
surfaces.consumer: host compact transport, scoped plan/Capture/Apply and checkpoint authority
surfaces.shape: duo-scope-contract/v1 and normalized compact scope request
surfaces.canonicalization: Duo\Canon v0 and exact scope_hash association

surfaces.shape: current plan JSON, additive value-free plan view and explanation document
surfaces.canonicalization: command JSON plus exact compiled artifact/revision associations

surfaces.consumer: Apply, scoped sessions, plan/explanation and recovery inventories
surfaces.shape: closed native/provider invocation inputs and provider-specific bounded receipts
surfaces.canonicalization: Duo\Canon hash bases with per-provider receipt format declarations

surfaces.shape: leases, sessions, journals, code descriptors and phase receipts
surfaces.canonicalization: versioned canonical documents and exact artifact/session hashes

surfaces.producer: standalone recovery runtime and host RecoveryProtocolCodec client
surfaces.consumer: host rollback authority/profile orchestration and recovery executor
surfaces.shape: duo-rollback-receipt/v2, duo-scoped-promotion-receipt/v1, duo-rollback-event/v1 and provider bundles
surfaces.canonicalization: compact recursively key-sorted JSON without trailing newline for signatures; persisted documents add one LF

surfaces.producer: future Thread 1 deterministic builder plus detached Thread 4 review/projection inputs
surfaces.consumer: Thread 2 adoption through ReleaseSelection and ArtifactTrustVerifier
surfaces.shape: separate host, target runtime, declarations, review bundle, projection pack, target release set and release-family manifests
surfaces.canonicalization: content-addressed payloads and compact canonical detached manifests; no manifest includes itself
